tools.name: memory_write
tools.intent: Persist a durable, project-scoped fact with its source path — one fact per entry, never raw chatter.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.intent: Search project/shared memory (scope=all, project, or shared) with 2-3 formulations before web or code search.

tools.name: memory_list
tools.intent: List entries in a project's memory bank, optionally filtered.

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.intent: Report bank size and entry counts for a project.

tools.name: memory_share
tools.intent: Promote a durable, cross-project entry to the shared tier — curated and never swept.

tools.name: memory_delete
tools.intent: Delete a specific memory entry by id.

tools.name: memory_delete_context
tools.intent: Delete entries by context; requires full access mode.

tools.name: memory_ingest_file
tools.intent: Bulk-load a file's contents into project memory as entries.

tools.name: memory_ingest_directory
tools.intent: Bulk-load every supported file under a directory into project memory.

tools.name: memory_embed_pending
tools.intent: Embed pending entries; omit the limit argument to process all.

tools.name: memory_workspace_begin
tools.intent: Start an isolated workspace outbox for in-progress notes.

tools.name: memory_workspace_status
tools.intent: List what the active workspace outbox holds.

tools.name: memory_workspace_consolidate
tools.intent: Finish a workspace: keep durable facts, promote cross-project ones with memory_share, drop the rest.

tools.name: memory_workspace_discard
tools.intent: Discard an active workspace and its outbox without consolidating.

tools.name: memory_sweep
tools.intent: Remove old, low-rated project entries; shared entries are exempt.

tools.name: memory_sync
tools.intent: Exchange memory snapshots with cloud storage when configured.

tools.name: memory_watch_add
tools.intent: Register an absolute path to mirror into memory; the initial scan runs in the background.

tools.name: memory_watch_status
tools.intent: Report watch state (scanning/healthy/retrying/stopped) for a project; empty when none.

tools.name: memory_watch_remove
tools.intent: Stop mirroring a watched path; a no-op when the path is not watched.
